title: When the Homeland Calls: Transnational Practices, Return Intentions, and the Political Integration of Vietnamese Migrants in Poland
core_idea: This study investigates how Vietnamese migrants' transnational practices (both political and non-political) relate to their political integration in Poland, distinguishing latent and manifest forms of participation. It asks whether political and non-political transnationalism operate as complements or substitutes and tests how migrants' return intentions moderate these relationships. The research applies complementarity and substitution perspectives and Carling and Pettersen’s model of return intentions, using quantitative analyses with robustness checks to assess impacts and moderation effects.
tldr: Examines whether and how political vs non-political transnational practices, moderated by return intentions, shape Vietnamese migrants' political integration in Poland using quantitative methods.
